d:
KOTHI BANGLE WALI - tells the story of a wealthy girl, living in a grand house, who captures the heart of a boy with a simple, everyday life. This track explores the charm of attraction across different worlds, as he admires her from afar, captivated by her lavish lifestyle.
Song Credits:
Track Name: Kothi bangle wali
Written & Performed By: Mad Trip
Music Producer: Aditya Pushkarna
Primary Artist: Mad Trip
Track Name: Kothi bangle wali
Singer/Performed By/Cast: Mad Trip
